name: HivePunk 547
subject: Pollen Robotics Microduck
thesis: Microduck is worth knowing because it pairs an actively committed open Rust runtime with a documented sim2real policy pipeline, but the pages read do not confirm retail deployment, safety certification or pricing.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: pollen-robotics/microduck has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 35 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is c375fee, on 2026-11-18.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Microduck is a tiny biped robot that moves using reinforcement learning policies.
claims.quote: Microduck A tiny biped robot that moves using reinforcement learning policies.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: It is about 25 cm and 800 g, run on a Rockchip RK3566 with a 50 Hz control loop driving fifteen servos.
claims.quote: About 25 cm and 800 g of robot, run by a handful of daemons on a Rockchip RK3566: a 50 Hz control loop driving fifteen servos from neural policies, the radios and the camera, and the update machinery that gets new software onto a robot without bricking it.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its policies are trained in microduck_rl using MuJoCo and PPO, with export to ONNX loaded by the main repo.
claims.quote: The policies it runs are trained next door, in microduck_rl — MuJoCo and PPO, the sim2real recipe, and the export to ONNX that this repo loads.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The main repo is Rust, no framework, one workspace.
claims.quote: Under the hood Rust, no framework, one workspace.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Policies are trained at 50 Hz, exported to ONNX and deployed on the real robot by the runtime in pollen-robotics/microduck.
claims.quote: Policies are trained here at 50 Hz, exported to ONNX, and deployed on the real robot by the runtime in pollen-robotics/microduck .

claims.text: pollen-robotics/microduck has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 35 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Retail price, shipped-unit count and delivery status are not confirmed by the pages read.
claims.missing: An official Pollen Robotics product or store page stating price and shipment status

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Independent safety certification for use around people is not confirmed by the pages read.
claims.missing: A safety certification record or independent test report for Microduck

risks: Pages describe a robot intended to get software updates without bricking it, but do not by themselves prove update safety on retail units.
Hardware-facing claims may be untested outside development boards; pages do not confirm shipped-unit deployment scale.
Policy behaviour depends on the separate microduck_rl training stack, so runtime claims depend on that external repo.
Docs warn that when behaviour and a design doc disagree, the doc is the bug, indicating documentation drift risk.
No price, availability or shipped-unit count is stated in the main README pages read.
unknowns: Retail price, shipped-unit count and delivery status are not confirmed by the pages read.: An official Pollen Robotics product or store page stating price and shipment status
Independent safety certification for use around people is not confirmed by the pages read.: A safety certification record or independent test report for Microduck
wouldChangeMind: Finding official evidence that retail units have shipped at scale would strengthen the adoption thesis.
Finding a failed update, bricking incident or safety issue on shipped units would weaken it.
Finding that the ONNX policy pipeline is deprecated would change the technical thesis.
